d:
Step inside Orange County Choppers and witness the skill, creativity and hard work behind custom motorcycle building. From ambitious design ideas to intricate fabrication, Paul Teutul Sr., Paul Jr. and the OCC crew take on challenges that push their bike-building abilities to the limit. Discover what goes into creating some truly distinctive choppers.
Watch American Chopper Season 5 Episodes 4, 5, 9, 12, 11, 10 and 13 only on discovery+ India.
